greeting: Dear OpenSesame Security and Compliance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Summer 2027 Security and Compliance Internship. I want to start my career in security, and your team covers the parts I most want to learn: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance, audit evidence, vendor risk and security awareness. I also like that you treat AI as part of how the work gets done, not a side topic. I finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine in June 2026, so I'm within your 12-month window.

The closest I've come to compliance work is owning the security and privacy controls of CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app I built and still operate on the App Store, running on Gemini Flash and Google Cloud. I implemented full account and data deletion and automated, scheduled data-retention cleanup, and I keep all credentials and secrets out of version control. I wrote role-based access-control rules that block IDOR, privilege escalation and message spoofing, and I check them with 36 adversarial unit tests. That work taught me to think about what a control promises and how to show it actually holds, which is a lot of what audit evidence is.

Building CommunicAI on Gemini Flash is also how I learned to work with AI day to day, including prompt engineering, and it would make a natural demo for the creative project. I'd enjoy finding a compliance workflow where AI saves real time. I'm studying for the CompTIA Security+ exam in January, and as captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I'm used to managing a full schedule and delivering on deadlines.
I'm available full-time, remotely, for the June 17 to August 28 program, and I'd be glad to talk more.
